name: Zhejiang Yasha Decoration Co.,Ltd
summary: Zhejiang Yasha Decoration Co.,Ltd engages in building and curtain wall decoration, intelligent system integration, and other businesses in China. The company is also involved in the design and construction of interior decoration projects; wholesale and retail of building materials; property management; e-commerce technology development; software development; sale of intelligent equipment; hotel management; and investment and asset management activities.
